register_model_with_decorator: use the registry.register_model decorator to register a new model class under a unique name key
register_task_with_decorator: use the registry.register_task decorator to register a new task class under a unique name key
get_class_by_name: use registry.get_class to look up a registered class by its name or fully qualified import path
register_state_value: use registry.register to store an arbitrary object in the registry state under a dot-separated key path
get_state_value: use registry.get to retrieve a stored value from the registry state by its dot-separated key path
